newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds follow lower Chicago futures.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds follow lower Chicago futures.

text.p: UK meals and feeds sellers were easier on Tuesday following the lower overnight close in Chicago.
However, buyers were holding back "for even lower prices", one broker said.
High protein soymeal sellers were two to five stg down ex-mill and 1.50 to 3.50 stg lower from the stores.
Rapemeal from Erith was unchanged while the Liverpool and Hull mills were one to three stg lower.
Sunflower pellets ex-mill and meal ex-store were also unchanged.
Corn gluten feed pellets ex-stores were unchanged to two stg up.
"There has been a lot of interest for spot gluten again, but no business as far as we know," said one broker.
In the south coast imported EU rapemeal traded at 134 stg for spot material.
